voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.45 s, atempo 1.04

lines.text: Kapag may nakita kang kalahating babae na nakatayo sa sagingan, huwag kang sisigaw. Hanapin mo ang asin.
lines.beat_before: hook: moonlight in a banana grove, a pair of legs standing, nothing above the waist

lines.text: Sa Visayas, sabi nila, may mga babaeng dalawa ang buhay.
lines.beat_before: a Visayan barrio at night: nipa huts on stilts, coconut trees, the moon
by day: a neighbour woman at her gate, waving (the same skirt)

lines.text: Sa gabi, iniiwan niya ang kalahati ng sarili niya.
lines.beat_before: night, the grove: the upper half lifts away from the lower, wings unfolding, against the moon

lines.text: Ang kalahati, nagkakapakpak, at naghahanap ng mga natutulog. Lalo na ng mga inang naghihintay ng anak.
lines.beat_before: a winged shape crosses the moon towards a hut; inside, a pregnant woman asleep, her husband awake with a bolo

lines.text: Mauuna mong maririnig ang mga pakpak. Tapos, hihilig ang apoy ng gasera papunta sa bubong.
lines.beat_before: wings outside; a shadow across the capiz window; the gasera flame leans towards the roof
the husband keeps his eyes down; a long tongue lowers between the nipa thatch

lines.text: Lumabas ka. Hanapin mo ang kalahating iniwan niya. Takpan mo ng asin, o abo, o bawang.
lines.beat_before: held silence; he looks at the window: her face in the broken capiz pane, wings spread outside, lit by the lamp (stinger in silence)

lines.text: Kapag hindi siya nakabalik bago sumikat ang araw,
lines.beat_before: he runs down the ladder into the grove with a jar of salt; the legs are still standing; he pours
wings beat behind him; a scream far off; silence; dawn: the legs fallen in the grass
